package.name: nros_runner_qemu_user
package.description:
The `qemu-user` runner (RFC-0118 D4b). Runs a cross-built hosted Linux image under QEMU's user mode: `qemu-<arch> <elf>`, the board's `[board.run] emulator = "qemu-user:<arch>"`. Its system calls are answered by the host's kernel, so a run is evidence for the image's user space, not for the target's kernel.
A runner package of the same shape as a user's: the announcement below is what the provider scan reads, `nros-runner.toml` is read only when this provider is the one selected, and the executable speaks RFC-0119 D6.
